entry.title: Detecting No-Progress in AI Agents Without Reading Prompts
entry.summary: A technical model for detecting AI coding-agent no-progress loops from action identity, outcomes, state and evidence—without treating raw prompts as required telemetry.

entry.title: Why an AI Agent Governor Should Start Powerless
entry.summary: Installing an AI agent governor should not automatically grant blocking authority. A safer runtime model starts in Shadow Mode and earns narrow enforcement from local evidence.
